headline_en: US-China chip licensing shifts to approvals while VIX stays calm at 18.65
headline_ko: 미중 반도체 규제 완화에 VIX 18.65로 안정
executive_bullets_en: Macro regime constructive at 68.8 with VIX calm despite Hormuz premiums and ongoing US-China licensing uncertainty
MU and CRWD show strongest technical setups with high RS and accumulation/uptrend structures
TSLA earnings in 3 days and multiple DOWNTREND names with Stage2 ≤2 require caution
executive_bullets_ko: 매크로 환경은 68.8점으로 건설적, 호르무즈 프리미엄과 미중 규제에도 VIX 18.65로 차분
MU와 CRWD가 높은 RS와 집적/상승 구조로 기술적 강세
TSLA 실적 3일 앞두고 하락 추세 종목 다수, Stage2 2점 이하 종목 주의 필요

market_mood.explanation_en: The 68.8 regime score sits in constructive territory like a river with steady flow but some rocks ahead. It suggests selective buying is reasonable but broad market participation remains limited.

big_picture.summary_en: US expanded AI chip export licensing to China now includes 25% tariff with case-by-case approvals and first approvals granted last week. Tanker traffic through Strait of Hormuz remains normal with war-risk premiums 40% above baseline and no new incidents in 48 hours. Federal court hearings on Google default deal remedies entered final phase with ruling expected within 30 days.
big_picture.summary_ko: 미국이 중국 AI 칩 수출 규제를 25% 관세와 개별 승인제로 전환했고 지난주 첫 승인이 나왔습니다. 호르무즈 해협 유조선 통행은 정상이나 전쟁 위험 보험료가 기준 대비 40% 높은 상태가 유지되고 있으며 구글 기본 검색 계약에 대한 구조적 구제 청문회가 최종 단계에 들어섰습니다.
big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX sits at 18.65, indicating markets are pricing geopolitical risks as contained rather than escalating.
big_picture.vix_note_ko: VIX가 18.65로, 시장이 지정학적 리스크를 아직 통제 가능한 수준으로 보고 있음을 보여줍니다.
big_picture.rates_note_en: 10-year yield at 4.60% remains elevated and continues to pressure growth valuations while supporting value and financial names.

big_picture.dollar_note_en: The dollar index (DXY) is at 101.00, providing a modest headwind for US tech multinationals with large overseas earnings.

big_picture.btc_note_en: Bitcoin is at $65,323.37, up 0.98% today and 0.94% over five days. This modest recovery signals selective risk appetite returning in crypto but not yet spilling broadly into equities.
